_comment: De-PII'd /v1/billing/balance/detail. Values are raw 'points' (cents*100). billingSlice.fetchBalanceDetail divides each by 10000 and toFixed(4). availableBalance 12345600 => '1234.5600' (asserted substring 1234.56). cashBalance 11110000 => '1111.0000'. Other fields 0 so only the Account-balance row renders (deterministic single row).
